topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Neighbor, I’ve been thinking on your ask about using a part of my yard for your garden. The soil there, it’s not like the rest—it’s thin, barely holds its own, even with the Lady’s blessing and all the hard labor I put in. The idea of turning that ground over, it’s a thought that keeps me tossing at night. I worry about what it might mean for the crops I need to see through the winter. But I see the hope in your eyes and the work you long to do. I’ll give it some more sun, see if the spirits smile upon us both. May St. Benedict watch over our seeds, let’s not speak of this to the rent collector, aye?
